subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` as the permanent cross-client/plugin contract for provider-neutral human input?
rationale: This PR introduces a new durable Gateway permission family and public plugin SDK subpath; the repository policy treats those compatibility-sensitive surfaces as requiring maintainer-visible direction beyond a mechanical patch review.

options.title: Sponsor the provider-neutral contract
options.body: Keep the new Gateway and SDK surface, first fixing native scope compatibility and delivery settlement before merge.

options.title: Narrow to an existing owner surface
options.body: Retain the user-facing capability but remove or redesign the new public plugin SDK contract around an already-approved interaction seam.

options.title: Defer the shared runtime
options.body: Keep the existing Codex-specific flow and reopen provider-neutral questions only with an approved cross-client API proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider-neutral contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new Gateway and SDK surface, first fixing native scope compatibility and delivery settlement before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged adjacent question surface and this proposed shared-runtime continuation.
